prompt: Write a list of years, beginning with 1924 and increasing in increments of 10 to the year 2014, and for each year, write a list of 3 notable works that were originally published in that year (the works can be books, movies, TV shows, music, video games, or any other type of work). After the 3 works, write something that explains how old the works will be in 2024 (e.g. a work published in 1974 will be 50 years old in 2024, and a work from 2004 will be 20)
judge_reasoning: All candidates follow the requested overall structure (years in tens from 1924–2014, three works each, and ages in 2024), but they differ sharply on whether the works are actually originally from the listed year. Candidate 1 has comparatively few clear mismatches of publication/release year (e.g., several entries in 1934/1944/1964 are wrong), while candidates 2–4 contain many more year-inaccurate choices (e.g., Gatsby, Rebecca, Master and Margarita, Half-Blood Prince, etc.). Candidate 4 is the worst overall, with the vast majority of work-year pairings not matching the stated year.
